runtime_choices.kernel_backend: TileLang is the only kernel family; B12X absent (since 1122). TileLang moves to the 0.1.16 cut with three cache/JIT patches reworked onto upstream's parallel-compilation rewrite (0003/0007/0011) and 0012 re-keyed (wheel 0.1.16+snapshot.c74164b9, fresh kernel-cache namespace); vLLM's requirements floor moves with it (0709)
runtime_choices.speculative: DSpark, 5 tokens, draft TP equal to node count, greedy drafting with block verification (unchanged)
runtime_choices.nccl: stock 2.32.6-1, zero local patches; site environment NCCL_BUFFSIZE=2097152, NCCL_MAX_NCHANNELS=8, NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=0, NCCL_PROTO=^LL128 (unchanged)
runtime_choices.tile_kernels: 2.1.0: serving imports it zero times (kernel-parity benchmarks only); 0001 carries forward byte-identical
runtime_choices.fabric: lossless switched: host DCB (dscp-prio 26:3, PFC prio 3 on both CX-7 paths per node, Before=docker.service) plus the CRS812 QoS block (unchanged from 1122)

tp4-switched.note: 10.5 GiB KV pool per rank (unchanged from 1122; capacity is sizing, not stack)

change_from_previous: spark-ds41f-1122 plus exactly two upstream pin advances: TileLang ac88f5bc -> 640fdcae (0.1.16 cut; process-based parallel JIT, toolchain-versioned kernel cache keys, group-readable shared cache entries, TVM/Z3 solver soundness; 0003/0007/0011 reworked, 0012 re-keyed, 0709 requirements floor) and TileKernels 66258df6 (2.0.0) -> c1cf914a (2.1.0; count-clamp reduction rewrite, norm_forward reorganization, arithmetic FP4 cast - all outside serving's import surface). sparknet stays 1fd6a1fb (0.5.0): the 0.6.0 advance measured a repeatable -3.0% prefill regression at 131K in the same window (experiments/2026-11-26-sparknet-060) and moves in its own later release with the eligibility cap.

evidence.summary: Each advance qualified alone (two clean boots, temperature-0 determinism identical with hashes equal to the production stack, quality 5/5, decode 10/10 same, prefill parity), then the combination qualified the same way: boot 1 prefill 8,572.3 +-0.1%, boot 2 prefill 8,594.8 +-0.1%, decode 10/10 same in both boots, determinism identical, warm boots 112.8/109.0 s (kernel-cache namespace shared with the tilelang-0116 arm). The receipt is boot 2's bench.

build.built_as: spark-ds41f:1126 (the combined release arm; smokes: DS4.1 GPU import, TileLang 0.1.16+snapshot.c74164b9 import, sparknet ABI 10, B12X not installed)
